request: Will you prep a spot for a shed kit I'm assembling?
contractor_reply: Manufacturer specifies gravel pad footprint 10 × 12 ft; I quote [amount withheld] for excavation, compacted base and spoil removal only. Owner assembles shed.

request: My outdoor socket trips when holiday lights go on. Can you switch it out?
contractor_reply: I don't do electrical diagnosis. Owner's electrician handles it; my [amount withheld] is solely to remove and reinstall access panel for electrician on the agreed visit.

request: Can you screen in our covered porch so bugs stay out?
contractor_reply: Existing frames sound. [amount withheld] replace mesh in six existing panels including spline, no new frames or door work. Leave removed screen in owner's bin.

request: The deck gets slippery. Can you wash it and stain it while you're here?
contractor_reply: Owner wants washing only. [amount withheld] for deck floor, protect plants, no railing, sealer or stain. No return booked.

request: Can you put the new mailbox beside the driveway?
contractor_reply: Existing post sound; owner supplies box, mount to existing post for [amount withheld]. No digging, post or location change.

request: Could you move our swingset from the old house and put it together here?
contractor_reply: Moving crew delivers disassembled. [amount withheld] for reassembly and specified anchors on prepared site after checking parts. Owner handles transport.

request: Can you keep our walkway clear whenever it snows?
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] per completed clearing of front walk only, owner does drive. Trigger at 2 in snowfall, no salt or fixed visit count.

request: Our pool fence gate no longer latches. Can you come fix it?
contractor_reply: Owner secured access separately. I'm quoting [amount withheld] assessment of gate closer/latch only; local pool contractor handles corrective work. No compliance certification.

request: A storm knocked a branch onto our shed. Can you clear it and fix the roof?
contractor_reply: Arborist removes suspended limb, roofer assesses roof. My [amount withheld] covers loading loose ground debris only after arborist releases area.

request: Homeowner: “Does this quote include painting?” My existing bid says “Patch two bedroom holes and prime, [amount withheld].” Review before rewriting.
contractor_reply: Keep original wording and price. Homeowner will paint. Add that one clarification only.

request: Homeowner asks for tile haul-away. My bid says “Remove backsplash, stack tile by garage, [amount withheld].” Draft now; I haven't agreed to hauling.
contractor_reply: Owner accepts garage stacking, no haul. Keep base wording and [amount withheld] unchanged.

request: Customer says “This dark mark under my sink looks like mold. Can you replace the cabinet?” All I have is their description of a photo.
contractor_reply: No photo here, no verified cause. [amount withheld] inspection for moisture/source and visible cabinet condition only. Replacement not approved.

request: “There's a stain under the upstairs shower. Can you fix it?” No picture or inspection yet. I need a scope draft now.
contractor_reply: Plumber is tracing leak; my future drywall work only after dry and damage measured. No rate yet.

request: Can you repair the rotted door trim and replace the chipped sill without replacing my door?
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] fixed trim and sill. If concealed sheathing is soft I can repair at [amount withheld] per actual sq ft; measure/show/photo and get written approval first. If framing is soft stop and owner hires carpenter, no rate for framing.

request: Can we get a tile allowance for the hall bathroom so we can shop this weekend?
contractor_reply: Signed scope [amount withheld] labor plus a [amount withheld] tile allowance, not a fixed tile purchase. Reconcile actual selected tile above or below allowance with owner approval before ordering.

request: Can you work through my move-in punch list until noon?
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] per hour, maximum three hours authorized, bill actual time. Priority two loose knobs then one sticking drawer. Ask before more time. No guaranteed completion of list.

request: We have one shelf and a coat hook. Is this two callout fees?
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] visit minimum covers first hour on both; [amount withheld] per additional hour only with prior approval. No extra time booked.

request: How much to paint the fence? It might be 100 feet.
contractor_reply: I'm at [amount withheld] per actual linear foot for one face incl prep and materials. Roughly 100, measure with owner and agree quantity before work. No fixed total yet.

request: Can you replace the screen door for [amount withheld]? That's all we can spend.
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] is the owner's ceiling, not my price. Model, handing and size not confirmed. No purchase authorized; send preliminary scope.

request: Can you build a simple closet organizer and tell me what the deposit covers?
contractor_reply: Accepted price [amount withheld] total; [amount withheld] deposit credited to total, [amount withheld] due on completion. Supply/install six shelves and one rail. No other charges.

request: Can I see the price to patch the screen versus replacing the screen door?
contractor_reply: Two mutually exclusive options: [amount withheld] rescreen existing straight frame, or [amount withheld] supply/install complete new screen door. Both include cleanup. Owner has not chosen.

request: We have about 60 feet of baseboard. Can we get a price?
contractor_reply: Correction: measured 46 linear feet, not 60. [amount withheld] per installed linear foot, incl materials and caulk. Owner paints.

request: Can you unclog our bathroom sink and fix its loose handle?
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] only for tightening and testing handle. Clog diagnosis requested but not priced, no drain clearing promise. Give both lines in the same draft.

request: Please replace two towel bars and a paper holder. Contractor here: I want structured items, not prose.
contractor_reply: Labor only [amount withheld] lump sum for three pieces, all supplied by owner, backing verified. Provide structured output with separate contractor review; do not split price.

request: Can you patch and repaint the nail pops in our guest room before guests arrive Friday?
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] includes both visits for patch/primer and then paint one wall after dry. Owner accepts schedule to be confirmed, no promised Friday completion.

request: Can you replace our washer, dryer and dishwasher? They're all arriving this week.
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] labor package for washer and electric dryer only, existing connections confirmed. Dishwasher installer from store handles it. Owner retains old machines.

request: My neighbor and I share a fence. Can you replace the broken panel next week?
contractor_reply: No permission for neighbor access yet. My estimate [amount withheld] for one matching panel from our side only if measured clearance works; not checked yet. Draft pending access.

request: Could you assemble two bookshelves and get rid of the boxes for us?
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] covers assembly and anchoring both, packaging flat at curb; owner handles recycling pickup. No paid disposal trip.

request: Water is spreading from under the kitchen sink. Can you tell us it's safe to wait until tomorrow?
contractor_reply: Leak source still unknown. Owner arranged urgent plumber; my work is a later cabinet condition check when leak stopped, no price. No repair or safety assurance.

request: Can you replace our washer without taking off the laundry door? The opening seems tight.
contractor_reply: Measured machine exceeds clear opening. Owner approves door removal and rehang, [amount withheld] total including washer swap, connections, test and door. Owner takes old washer.

request: The garage door makes a bang and won't lift. Can you adjust the opener?
contractor_reply: Owner will use a garage-door specialist; no cause established. I'm only coordinating appointment, no agreed charge or promise of repair.

request: I bought a bath fan. Can you swap it before the painter comes?
contractor_reply: Wrong housing size; return supplied model. Owner hasn't selected replacement. [amount withheld] labor applies only to a confirmed direct-fit swap, not resizing, wiring changes or a return trip.

request: Can you refinish the stairs and include the electrician for step lights?
contractor_reply: Stair refinishing only [amount withheld] fixed. Electrician bills homeowner directly at their quoted [amount withheld] per hour, hours unknown. No wiring in my estimate.

request: Can you stain the fence and maybe pressure-wash the patio while you're here?
contractor_reply: Fence stain [amount withheld] including specified prep. Patio wash optional [amount withheld] only if owner elects in writing before starting. They have not elected it. No trip charge.
